item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President merely invokes authority and introduces Section 1; this segment contains no operative governance direction or legal consequence.","evidence":"it is hereby ordered as follows— Section 1."},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately delegates specified presidential functions to the Director of the Bureau of the Budget, who may exercise those authorities later without further presidential approval; this is an internal assignment of executive authority rather than a dictated substantive outcome.","evidence":"The Director of the Bureau of the Budget is hereby designated and empowered to exercise, without the approval, ratification, or other action of the President, the following:"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately supersedes prior executive orders, updates cross-references, and preserves earlier actions until later modification or termination; these are administrative housekeeping and continuity provisions.","evidence":"The following are hereby superseded:"}]}
